seoTitle: How to Get a Manus AI Invitation Code (Do You Still Need One?)
metaDescription: Manus AI opened public sign-up in 2025, so an invitation code is no longer required. Here's how sign-up actually works now, what invite codes do today, and OpenManus as a separate open-source option.
intro: Manus AI's invitation-only period is over. Manus opened public registration on May 13, 2025, a little over two months after its March 2025 launch, so anyone can sign up directly today with no request form and no waiting queue. If you're reading a guide that describes filling out an access request and waiting days for an approval email, it's describing that closed launch window, not how sign-up works now. This guide covers the current sign-up, what an invitation code actually does today, and why paying anyone for one is pointless.
costNote: Signing up is free, and every account gets a one-time credit bonus plus a smaller daily allowance at no cost, enough to try real tasks. Continuous or heavier use requires a paid Manus plan once free credits run out. Exact credit amounts and plan pricing are the kind of thing Manus adjusts over time, so treat any specific figure here as a snapshot rather than a permanent number.

steps.heading: Sign up directly, no invitation required
steps.body: Go to manus.im and click Sign up. Create an account with an email address or a Google account. There's no invitation code, request form, or approval wait built into that process anymore. This screenshot shows the request form Manus used during its original invite-only period, before public registration opened; guides built around it are describing a step that no longer exists.

image.caption: The Manus AI request form from the platform's original invite-only period, before public registration opened in May 2025. Signing up no longer goes through this form.

steps.heading: Collect your free credits
steps.body: New accounts receive a one-time signup credit bonus plus a smaller allowance that renews daily, both automatically and at no cost. Credits are what Manus tasks consume, so there's nothing to buy just to start experimenting with the tool.

steps.heading: Use a referral code for bonus credits, not for access
steps.body: Manus still has invitation links, but their job changed: sharing your link with a friend now earns both of you bonus credits when they sign up, rather than being the only door into the product. If someone hands you a referral link or code, redeeming it can still add credits on top of the standard signup bonus, but Manus's own redemption page limits this to accounts registered within the last three months, one redemption per month, so an old saved code may simply no longer apply.

steps.heading: Consider OpenManus if you specifically want something open source
steps.body: OpenManus, built by the MetaGPT team and available at openmanus.org, is a separate project, not Manus AI itself, aiming to replicate similar agent-style functionality. It's worth a look if you want something free and self-hostable on its own merits. It's no longer a workaround for anything, since Manus's own sign-up has no wait attached to it.

steps.heading: Ignore anyone selling an invitation code for money
steps.body: Some sites and individual sellers still list Manus invitation codes for sale, a holdover from mid-2025 when demand outstripped invites and codes briefly resold for real money on secondary markets. Sign-up is now free, immediate, and needs nothing but an email address, so there's no functioning shortcut left for a paid code to unlock. Treat any offer to sell you one as a scam.

troubleshooting.problem: An invitation or referral code doesn't seem to do anything
troubleshooting.cause: Manus limits redemption to accounts registered within the last three months, and once per month even within that window.
troubleshooting.fix: Check how old the account is. Outside that window the code won't apply, and it was never required for sign-up in the first place.

troubleshooting.problem: A site wants payment before it will give you a Manus invitation code
troubleshooting.cause: Leftover resale activity from the 2025 invite shortage, plus the persistent myth that Manus is still hard to get into.
troubleshooting.fix: Skip it and sign up directly at manus.im. There is nothing a paid code unlocks that a free sign-up doesn't already give you.

faq.question: Do I still need an invitation code to sign up for Manus AI?
faq.answer: No. Manus opened public registration on May 13, 2025. Anyone can sign up directly at manus.im with an email or Google account, with no code or approval wait.

faq.question: What does an invitation or referral code do now?
faq.answer: It adds bonus credits when a new user signs up through your link, on top of the standard signup bonus every account gets. It's a referral perk, not a requirement.

faq.question: Is it safe to buy a Manus AI invitation code online?
faq.answer: No. Since sign-up is free and open to anyone already, a paid code has nothing left to unlock. Treat sellers as a scam and sign up directly instead.

faq.question: What is OpenManus, and do I need it to use Manus AI?
faq.answer: OpenManus is a separate, open-source project built by the MetaGPT team, available at openmanus.org, with similar agent-style functionality. It's an independent alternative for people who want something free and self-hostable, not something needed to access Manus AI itself.

faq.question: How much does Manus AI cost after the free credits run out?
faq.answer: Manus offers paid plans for continued or heavier use once the free signup and daily credit allowance is used up. Check manus.im/pricing for current plan details, since pricing and credit amounts change over time.
